name: 中级模板-实验蜘蛛
data:
#中级模板注释会更少，还请留意
[core]
name: experimentalSpiderTemplate
class: CustomUnitMetadata
#price: 2
price: 70000

maxHp: 10000
mass: 90000

isPickableStartingUnit: true
startFallingWhenStartingUnit: true

#单位标题
displayText:示范实验蜘蛛

#单位描述
displayDescription:强大的实验蜘蛛，死亡会核爆，不错的攻击和高耐久度。请参考ini里面的注释和结合代码表使用。


techLevel: 1
experimental: true

buildSpeed: 0.0002
#buildSpeed: 1

#availableInDemo: true

radius: 39
displayRadius: 39


fogOfWarSightRange:19

transportSlotsNeeded: 8

isBio: false
isBuilder: true

softCollisionOnAll: 3

#nanoFactorySpeed:2.5

generation_credits: 18
generation_delay: 40

selfRegenRate:0.4

#builtFrom_1_name: commandCenter
#builtFrom_1_pos:  2

builtFrom_1_name: experimentalLandFactory
builtFrom_1_pos:  6.1

energyMax: 2
energyRegen: 0.0003


canRepairBuildings: true
canRepairUnits : true

canReclaimResources: true

autoRepair: true

nanoRange: 220

nanoRepairSpeed: 0.4
nanoBuildSpeed: 8

#死亡核爆
nukeOnDeath: true
#核爆范围
nukeOnDeathRange: 200
#核爆伤害
nukeOnDeathDamage: 4400
#启用禁核后是否继续生效
nukeOnDeathDisableWhenNoNuke: true

#可建造这个也可以封装为一个节
[canBuild_1]
name: builder
pos:  1
#强制为建筑建造，无论目标是不是建筑单位
forceNano: true

[canBuild_2]
name: combatEngineer
pos:  1
forceNano: true

[canBuild_3]
name: heavyTank
pos:  1
forceNano: true

[canBuild_4]
name: heavyHoverTank
pos:  1
forceNano: true

[canBuild_5]
name: artillery
pos:  1
forceNano: true

[canBuild_6]
name: scout
pos:  1
forceNano: true

[canBuild_7]
name: turret, turret_artillery, antiAirTurret
pos:  0.1

[canBuild_8]
name: extractor
pos:  0.3

[canBuild_9]
name: landFactory, mechFactory, airFactory
pos:  0.4

[canBuild_10]
name: laserDefence, repairBay
pos:  0.5

[canBuild_11]
name: bomber
pos:  1
forceNano: true

[canBuild_showReclaimAction]
name: reclaim
pos:  -1

#Luke的蜘蛛跳舞 官方烂活
[action_dance]
addEnergy: 0
displayType: action
price:  0

#多语言
text: Dance
text_zh:跳舞

buildSpeed: 5.5s
whenBuilding_cannotMove: true
whenBuilding_playAnimation:dance

#Luke的蜘蛛攻击跳舞 官方烂活
[action_attack_dance]
addEnergy: 0
displayType: action
price:  0

#多语言
text: Attack
text_zh:攻击跳舞

buildSpeed: 4.5s
whenBuilding_playAnimation:attack


[graphics]
#实验级
drawLayer: experimentals

total_frames: 1

image:        CORE:/experimental_spider/body.png
image_wreak:  CORE:/experimental_spider/body_dead.png
image_turret: SHARED:nano_turret.png
#scaleImagesTo: 20
#scaleTurretImagesTo: 9

#teamColorsOnTurret: true

image_shadow: AUTO
shadowOffsetX:3
shadowOffsetY:3

[attack]
canAttack: true
canAttackFlyingUnits: true
canAttackLandUnits:   true
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false

turretSize: 30
turretTurnSpeed: 2
maxAttackRange: 290
shootDelay: 85

turretMultiTargeting: true

y: 18

[projectile_cannonShot]

#directDamage: 0 #no directDamage with targetGround
life: 150
speed: 5

frame: 2

life: 80

drawType:2
frame:4
drawSize: 1

#trailEffectRate: true

#lightColor:#ffffff

life: 14

[movement]

[ai]
